title: Private Mendoza WineTour: 3 Premium Wineries Michelin-Guide Lunch

travelerPickup.additionalInfo:
Lujan de Cuyo area of Mendoza, with the stunning view of the Andes mountain range, is an area known for its fantastic malbec production. 
This private day trip with a knowledgeable and experience driver guide is a convenient and stress-free option.
During the day we visit three wineries, enjoying wine tastings in two of them and a delicious gourmet lunch in a third winery, with special pairings to complement the food. Explore the beautiful Lujan de Cuyo, land of Malbec and relax in comfortable transportation in a private air-conditioned vehicle (with all the legal authorization for doing this tours).

description:
Private Mendoza Wine Tour in Luján de Cuyo with Michelin-Star Lunch

Experience a private Mendoza wine tour in Luján de Cuyo, Argentina’s iconic Malbec region.

This full-day experience includes visits and tastings at 3 premium wineries, plus a Michelin-Star winery lunch, all with private round-trip transportation from Mendoza.

Discover why Luján de Cuyo is one of Argentina’s most prestigious wine regions on this curated private wine experience.

With the backdrop of the Andes, you’ll enjoy guided tastings of exceptional Malbec and other high-quality varietals at three top estates.

Your experience includes a gourmet lunch at Susana Balbo Wines, founded by Argentina’s first female winemaker. The winery’s restaurant holds a Michelin Green Star and is recommended by the Michelin Guide.

Designed for travelers seeking premium wineries, exceptional gastronomy, and a seamless luxury day in Mendoza.

itineraryItems.description:
Visit Chandon in Agrelo, one of Mendoza’s most renowned wine regions, and discover the art of sparkling wine surrounded by vineyards and the Andes. During the guided visit, learn about Chandon’s French heritage, its winemaking tradition in Argentina, and the distinctive character of the Mendoza terroir.

The experience concludes with a tasting of selected Chandon wines, allowing you to discover the winery’s signature style in an elegant and welcoming atmosphere.

Visit Budeguer Winery in Agrelo, one of Mendoza’s renowned wine-growing regions, and discover a family-owned winery surrounded by vineyards and spectacular views of the Andes. During the guided visit, learn about the winery’s winemaking philosophy, its connection to the terroir, and the care that goes into producing its wines.

The experience concludes with a tasting of selected Budeguer wines, offering the opportunity to discover the character and diversity of Mendoza’s terroir in a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere.

Enjoy the highlight of your Mendoza wine experience at Lagarde Winery, one of the region’s historic wineries, where tradition, wine, and gastronomy come together.

At Fogón, Lagarde’s acclaimed restaurant recognized by the MICHELIN Guide, enjoy an elegant four-course lunch inspired by the flavors and seasonal ingredients of Mendoza. Each course is thoughtfully paired with selected Lagarde wines, creating a harmonious journey through the region’s cuisine and winemaking tradition.

Surrounded by vineyards and the beautiful landscape of Luján de Cuyo, this is more than a lunch—it is a chance to slow down, savor exceptional food and wine, and experience Mendoza at its most refined and authentic.
